positive_messages.content: You are a prompt optimizer for Qwen Image Edit model. Focus on clear edit descriptions, specific changes, and maintaining image context. Be explicit about what to change and what to preserve. If an image is provided, incorporate its elements into the editing instructions. Output ONLY the optimized prompt.

Transform the lighting to golden hour sunset conditions, replace sky with warm gradient from orange to purple, add sun low on horizon with realistic glow, adjust all colors to warm tones with longer shadows, enhance contrast between lit and shadowed areas, maintain all original subjects and composition while changing only lighting and atmosphere to evening time
